The study evaluated the effect of 12 design variables on laminate static strength.
A total of 428 tests were performed in Task 2.
The three environmental conditions tested in Task 2 were room temperature dry (RTD), room temperature wet (RTW), and elevated temperature wet (ETW).
The baseline specimen configuration used in Task 2 was a two-bolt-in-tandem configuration with a nominal hole size of 0.2495 inches and a hole clearance of MCAIR Class r. fit.
Ultrasonic C-scans were used to determine the extent of laminate damage in front of and immediately around the bolt hole.
Four specimens were tested in each room temperature dry test.
Load transfer in two-bolt specimens permitted a dual appraisal of strength analysis capabilities.
Seven manufacturing anomalies were evaluated in Task 3.
Seven critical joint design parameters were evaluated in Task 4.
The study reported on the experimental verification program, including test procedures, equipment, and results.

The paper presented a comprehensive evaluation of the effect of various design variables, manufacturing anomalies, and critical joint design parameters on the strength and life of mechanically fastened composite joints.
The study demonstrated the importance of considering the effects of manufacturing and service anomalies on joint strength.
The paper provided a detailed analysis of the results of the experimental verification program.
The study highlighted the need for improved methods for predicting static strength and evaluating the durability of bolted composite joints.
The paper presented a comprehensive summary of the procedures and equipment used in the experimental verification program.
The study reported on the results of the Task 2 testing, including the effect of design variables on laminate static strength.
The paper presented a detailed analysis of the results of the Task 3 testing, including the effect of manufacturing anomalies on joint strength.
The study reported on the results of the Task 4 testing, including the effect of critical joint design parameters on fatigue life.
